skills.title: ON LEARNING
skills.quote: Once you stop learning, you start dying.

projects.name: Procurement Multi-Agent
projects.body: End-to-end AI procurement optimization for a Mexican fuel-station network of 617 stations (~$9.5B USD baseline). Orchestrator with 7 local tools + 3 parallel web-search sub-agents cut risk assessment latency 57% (210s→90s). Shipped a bilingual Streamlit dashboard with KPI strip, supplier mix, and conversational agent.

projects.name: MARL for Network Intrusion Detection
projects.body: AI-driven cybersecurity defense system using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning to protect critical network assets under resource constraints. Enterprise networks modeled as graphs via GNNs to make agents topology-aware. 47% improvement over baseline using PPO.

projects.name: Sepsis Detection via Diffusion
projects.body: Conditional Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model for medical time-series. Treats vital-sign forecasting as a generative re-painting task to visualize outcome distributions — a cloud of outcomes instead of one LSTM point estimate. 1D ResNet w/ sinusoidal time-step embeddings.

projects.name: Healthcare Data Warehouse
projects.body: Normalized PostgreSQL schema (3NF) + Star Schema warehouse for hospital revenue and patient workload analytics. Automated dbt pipeline engineering Fact/Dimension tables. Full stack containerized. Indexing cut query time 616ms→53ms (~90%).

projects.name: Deafine
projects.body: Python accessibility tool delivering real-time speaker detection and live transcription via the ElevenLabs STT API for deaf and hard-of-hearing users. WebSocket audio with batched calls during silence. Won Best Use of ElevenLabs at the MLH-UB Hackathon.

projects.name: Multi-Modal Genre Prediction
projects.body: Fusion model combining LSTM-encoded plot summaries and MLP-encoded poster images to classify movie genre across 100,000+ films. Custom augmentation + undersampling to handle class imbalance across six genres. 72% accuracy on the integrated multi-modal system.

cv.body: Engineered an end-to-end AI procurement optimization system for a Mexican fuel-station network operating 617 stations with a ~$189B MXN ($9.5B USD) annual baseline, targeting 5–15% cost reduction. Designed a multi-agent system (1 orchestrator, 7 tools, 3 parallel web-search sub-agents) cutting risk-assessment latency 57% (210s→90s) on LangChain + LangGraph. Built a 4-stage ingestion pipeline over 7,251 supplier files across PDF/HTML/XLSX/TXT, a 0–100 Leakage Score over 252,117 historical orders, and a MILP order-splitting optimizer. Shipped a production Streamlit dashboard with a bilingual conversational procurement agent. Coordinated a team of 3.

Collaborated with senior data scientists to collect, clean, and preprocess datasets from diverse sources using Python and pandas. Created visualizations of user-behavior trends for stakeholders. Built a VADER-based sentiment analyzer that automatically classified user feedback for the product team.

Developed expertise in Generative Diffusion Models, Reinforcement Learning, and neural network design. Led collaborative teams to build and optimize predictive models, manage high-performance data workflows, and scale neural architectures. Coursework: Data Intensive Computing, Numerical Methods for Data Science, Reinforcement Learning, Computer Vision, Pattern Recognition, Basics of AI, Intro to ML.

Developed skills in problem solving, leadership, time management, product planning, solution delivery, and cross-team collaboration over four years of engineering. Coursework: Data Mining, Web Algorithms, Information Retrieval, Machine Learning, Big Data, Financial Accounting, Operations Research.
